mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK ( RAW_DATA_ID, TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, REQUEST_TYPE, STATUS, ATTEMPT_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{rawDataId}, #{transformRuleVersionId}, #{requestType}, #{status}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: UPDATE SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK SET STATUS = 'RUNNING', ATTEMPT_COUNT = ATTEMPT_COUNT + 1, STARTED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRANSFORM_TASK_ID IN ( SELECT TRANSFORM_TASK_ID FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CREATED_AT, TRANSFORM_TASK_ID LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING TRANSFORM_TASK_ID, RAW_DATA_ID, TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, REQUEST_TYPE, STATUS, ATTEMPT_COUNT, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT

SELECT TRANSFORM_TASK_ID, RAW_DATA_ID, TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, REQUEST_TYPE, STATUS, ATTEMPT_COUNT, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK WHERE TRANSFORM_TASK_ID = #{transformTaskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK SET STATUS = 'SUCCESS', FINISHED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ERROR_MESSAGE = NULL, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRANSFORM_TASK_ID = #{transformTaskId} AND STATUS = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK SET STATUS = 'FAILED', FINISHED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRANSFORM_TASK_ID = #{transformTaskId} AND STATUS = 'RUNNING'
